lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Top plate (outer 1) to side wall A (outer 5), ~90.3 deg formed fold. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer-skin apex of the radius (bisector excess 0.00/0.008/0.006 mm; nearest point 0.21/0.03/0.12 mm). The line is parallel to the fold, and points within 2 mm cover the whole length (t -0.7..209.4 vs line 0..208.6), so it spans the full fold. The free-edge corner notches on this wall do not reach the fold.
